title: Reconcile merges on shared main carry their real date
goal: `local-distill submit-main` wrote its reconcile merge onto development main with the fixed composition date 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z (main head ca8309f47, shown by the host as made 'yesterday'). Merges published to shared main now record the time they were made; composition commits keep the fixed date for reproducible candidates and receipts.

results.tests: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-distill: 19 passed / 0 failed; the extended submit_main_reconciles_concurrent_peer_commits... test fails on the old code ('merge dated 1794268800, now 1794386753') and passes with the fix

limitations: ca8309f47 already on main keeps its misleading date; published history is never rewritten.
